caption: The drawing depicts a scene with multiple human figures grouped mainly in the center and right of the composition. On the left side, an individual dressed in a red shirt and blue hat sits on a raised, circular platform with a blue railing or stair, against a background of red drapery. This seated person faces a group of four men who are standing or moving toward the right, where one central figure, wearing a blue shirt, red shorts, and blue hat, extends his arms as if gesturing or restraining another. To the right, a partially unclothed, long-haired figure stands near a large, white, cylindrical object, with several other standing men around; these men wear various outfits including hats and tunics in shades of red, blue, brown, and green. The background is shaded in brown tones, with the floor area transitioning to dark blue and beige. All the figures display simplified, stylized forms, and the colors used are muted, dominated by earth tones, blues, and reds.
title: Station of the Cross No. 1: "Jesus is Condemned to Death"
